changelog:
v2.6.2 — UNFREEZE HOTFIX:

🎯 Fixed: frozen apps refusing to unfreeze. Root cause — the app trusted pm's exit code, but on some Samsung builds pm prints an error and still exits 0, so unfreeze "succeeded" while the app stayed frozen.

✅ Now every freeze/unfreeze is VERIFIED against the device's real disabled-package list before reporting success.

✅ Unfreeze tries both pm enable forms (with and without --user flag) automatically.

✅ If the device ever refuses, you'll see exactly which step failed instead of silent success.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.1.
